A '''capital ship''', slightly smaller than a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], was used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] at the [[Battle of Kalarba]]. It contributed to the destruction of the [[Bothan Assault Cruiser]] [[Champion (Bothan Assault Cruiser)|''Champion'']].
